trigger: DEV-CAL-3 terminal CHARGE_CARRIER_MULTIPLE (PR #353 merged 88a66321): the DEV-CAL-2 V2 AMORTISATION_DOMINATED negative is carried by the acquisition (mining) charge in its full-charge no-retirement form (57.83% of cell-B total burden); failures, verification and salvage are exonerated as carriers (DEV_CAL_3_EXONERATED_COMPONENT_INVARIANTS_V1.json, standing). Under NO_MINING_CHARGE and under MARGINAL_COST_ONLY the secondary (total-burden) readout flips to recovery on tiers KO-2/KO-3/KO-4 with the KO-2 primary transfer (1.0000) intact, Holm adjusted p = 0.0, at every sensitivity N in {5,10,25}.
central_question: under the corrected acquisition-charging semantics — amortised acquisition charge with retirement-after-N, with N fixed by the pre-registered derivation rule below and NOTHING else — does the DEV-CAL-2 secondary (total_burden_incl_acquisition) readout recover on the tiers that carry the primary transfer, with the KO-2 primary transfer intact, on the sealed V2 task stream?

method.no_new_protected_run: no new worlds, seeds, arms-at-runtime, or scored execution; the sealed V2 event/cost ledgers are the sole input, bound by exact path + sha256 in the analysis receipt BEFORE recomputation (same input set as the DEV-CAL-3 freeze: results/DEV_CAL_2_SCORED_RESULTS_V1.json + _V2.json, results/DEVCAL2_RESULTS_V2.json, receipts/DEVCAL2_receipts_shard{1..4}_V2.jsonl, receipts/DEVCAL2_HOST_RECEIPT_billy_V2.json; plus this freeze, the DEV-CAL-3 analysis receipt and the exonerated-component invariants file as control targets)
method.implementation: the semantics is the UNCHANGED DEV-CAL-3 MARGINAL_COST_ONLY implementation (exact.devcal3_charging_attribution.semantics_totals with semantics='MARGINAL_COST_ONLY', mco_n=N_FROZEN): per-world raw acquisition cost = the sealed ORACLE anchor row's cost_ledger.acquisition (never recomputed); each of the first N_FROZEN uses in the registered canonical use order (ORACLE s0-2, SHUFFLED s0-2, then ALL_KO_ARMS x seeds, 1-indexed) charges raw/N_FROZEN; uses after N_FROZEN charge zero acquisition (retired); RESET charges zero; work readouts never touched. NO line of exact/devcal3_charging_attribution.py, exact/run_devcal2.py or src/ocm may be edited by this lane; the recompute imports them unchanged.
method.leakage_rule: identical to DEV-CAL-3: semantics applied POST HOC to recorded events only; no event, order, or outcome re-simulated, re-ordered, or dropped (event identity digests re-verified per row under the frozen semantics)

frozen_semantics.name: MARGINAL_COST_ONLY_AT_FROZEN_N
frozen_semantics.statement: amortised acquisition charge with retirement-after-N_FROZEN: the acquisition (mining) charge is amortised across the asset's measured use lifetime and retires after N_FROZEN uses; no other charge component changes (failures, verification, salvage, retrieval, adaptation stay AS_IS per the standing DEV-CAL-3 exonerated-component invariants)
frozen_semantics.single_change_clause: this freeze authorises EXACTLY ONE charging change (the acquisition amortisation horizon); any second charging change, any touching of the exonerated components, or any re-tuning of another charge is out of scope and forbidden in-lane

N_derivation_rule.registered: N is fixed by the following rule, written into this freeze BEFORE any count is taken or any N recorded; the rule is computed ONLY from the sealed V2 receipt shards bound by this freeze
N_derivation_rule.rule: N_FROZEN = min over world_ids w present in the sealed V2 shard rows of U(w), where U(w) = the number of status=OK rows in the sealed shards whose world_id is w and whose (arm, seed) lies in the registered canonical use order (arm in {ORACLE_HISTORY, SHUFFLED_HISTORY} union ALL_KO_ARMS, seed in {0,1,2}); RESET rows are never uses. Worlds with U(w)=0 are excluded from the min (no uses -> no acquisition charge to amortise; their absence cannot shrink N).
N_derivation_rule.derivation_meaning: measured break-even horizon, conservative form: U(w) is the asset's observed use lifetime in world w; N_FROZEN = the use lifetime of the least-used world; equivalently N_FROZEN is the LARGEST single N such that every world still pays its full raw acquisition cost exactly once across its observed uses (total charged per world = raw * min(U(w), N) / N = raw for all w when N = min U(w)); no world's acquisition cost is written off early, the amortisation is spread as wide as one-time full recovery permits, and any use beyond a world's break-even horizon is charged at marginal cost only
N_derivation_rule.outcome_blindness: the derivation reads ONLY the sealed shard rows (event/task/arm/world/seed/status fields); no recovery readout, tier, threshold, p-value, recorded MCO grid entry, or any other analysis output may enter the derivation; selecting N to favour an outcome is forbidden and void
N_derivation_rule.guards: empty min-set (no world with U(w)>=1) -> CANNOT_CHECK_N_DERIVATION_NO_USED_WORLDS; N_FROZEN < 1 -> CANNOT_CHECK_N_DERIVATION_DEGENERATE; ties impossible (integer min over a nonempty finite set); the derivation must be recomputed and recorded verbatim in the analysis receipt with per-world U(w) counts

controls.as_is_exact_equality: the AS_IS recomputation (unchanged DEV-CAL-2 statistics over the sealed rows) must reproduce every DEV_CAL_2_SCORED_RESULTS_V2.json comparable field exactly (registered 1e-12 relative float-bind tolerance for rollup-summation-order noise, every tolerance-bound field NAMED; any other mismatch = ASSAY_DEFECT, the analysis halts with no frozen-semantics number reported) — identical gate to DEV-CAL-3 stage 1
controls.machinery_control_N10: this lane's recomputation at N=10 must reproduce the recorded DEV_CAL_3_ATTRIBUTION_RESULTS_V1.json charge_semantics.MARGINAL_COST_ONLY block field-for-field (per_arm recovery shares + nulls + draw-invariance + controls + purity + adapter digests, ladder_state, recovering_tiers, draw_invariance_conflict_tiers, ko2_primary_intact, evidence_arm, p_one_sided, verdict_if_this_were_the_model) and the marginal_cost_sensitivity entries at N in {5,25} (recovering_tiers, ko2_primary_intact, p_one_sided) — exact equality required (registered 1e-12 float-bind tolerance, named fields); any mismatch = ASSAY_DEFECT
controls.frozen_N_readout: the MARGINAL_COST_ONLY readout is recomputed at N_FROZEN. If N_FROZEN in {5,10,25}: exact equality with the corresponding recorded entry is REQUIRED (full block for 10; sensitivity summary fields for 5/25). If N_FROZEN not in {5,10,25}: every field that differs from the recorded N=10 block must be listed and explained field-by-field; expected difference class: acquisition-charge redistribution across arms as N_FROZEN changes which canonical positions pay (secondary/total-burden fields only).
controls.work_readout_invariance: under MARGINAL_COST_ONLY at ANY N, every work-derived readout (primary recovery shares, work draw-invariance, purity, controls, adapter digests, event identity) must be IDENTICAL to the recorded N=10 values (MCO never touches work and never touches events); a violation = ASSAY_DEFECT
controls.leakage_and_direction: event preservation (identity digests) and direction sanity (no row's total burden exceeds its AS_IS total) re-verified under the frozen semantics, exactly as in DEV-CAL-3; violation = ASSAY_DEFECT

endpoint_and_stats.primary_endpoint: KO-2_PLUS_RETRIEVAL secondary (total_burden_incl_acquisition) recovery in cell B under the frozen semantics: recovery_share mean >= 0.25 (the inherited frozen DEV-CAL-2 materiality threshold) with CI excluding 0 and shuffle-null non-alarm and draw-invariance no-conflict, WHILE the KO-2 primary transfer stays intact (primary threshold_met with null non-alarm, draw_invariance AGREE_DETERMINATE 3/3, controls A fired C/D silent, purity unchanged)
endpoint_and_stats.secondary_endpoint: the full per-arm ladder + LOO secondary/primary table under the frozen semantics (all 8 arms reported), plus the recorded-grid cross-reference
endpoint_and_stats.stats: single pre-registered hypothesis: one-sided signflip permutation test (PERM_N=10000, frozen seed tag) on the KO-2 paired secondary shares at alpha=0.05; Holm-Bonferroni is not applicable to a single hypothesis (the DEV-CAL-3 five-arm Holm result stands as parent context); NULL_BAND_GATED_V1 (AM-5 standing) direction tests; registered 20% margin inherited
endpoint_and_stats.decision_rule: controls all pass AND KO-2 secondary threshold_met AND KO-2 primary intact AND no draw-invariance conflict on any recovering tier -> POSITIVE_RECOVERY_UNDER_FROZEN_SEMANTICS; controls pass but KO-2 secondary not met (or conflict) -> PERSISTENT_NON_RECOVERY

terminals.operational_reading: RECEIPT_BINDING_DEFECT and ASSAY_DEFECT halt the analysis BEFORE any frozen-semantics number is reported (inherited DEV-CAL-3 discipline); when a halt fires, its terminal is reported. CANNOT_CHECK fires when a registered guard (e.g. N-derivation degenerate) or a missing input makes the endpoint unevaluable — never silently.

meaning.POSITIVE_RECOVERY_UNDER_FROZEN_SEMANTICS: under the frozen amortised-acquisition semantics with N_FROZEN from the registered rule, the DEV-CAL-2 secondary readout recovers on the minimal tier carrying the primary transfer, primary intact — scoped strictly by the claim ceiling below
meaning.PERSISTENT_NON_RECOVERY: the corrected charging semantics does NOT restore secondary recovery: the non-amortisation is not repaired by amortised acquisition charging alone and the negative stands at this scope
meaning.RECEIPT_BINDING_DEFECT: any sealed-input sha256 mismatch vs the committed digest sources
meaning.ASSAY_DEFECT: any control failure (AS_IS mismatch, N=10 machinery mismatch, work-readout invariance breach, leakage/direction violation)

claim_ceiling: any recovery statement is scoped ONLY to the sealed V2 task stream (the 120-world DEV-CAL-2 matrix, 3960 verified rows) under the frozen semantics; NO horizon generalisation (no claim about amortisation horizons beyond N_FROZEN and the recorded sensitivity grid), NO new-stream claim, NO economics/OCM-residual/open-endedness claim (economics = M3 territory), NO oracle-transplant headline comparator, NO new terminal for DEV-CAL-2 itself (the V2 verdict stands; DEV-CAL-3's attribution stands)
forbidden: touching any charge component other than the acquisition amortisation horizon: failures, verification and salvage stay AS_IS per DEV_CAL_3_EXONERATED_COMPONENT_INVARIANTS_V1.json (standing invariants, bound by sha256)
designing, deploying or evaluating a SECOND charging change in this lane (any further charging redesign is a separate prospective registration)
any new scored/protected run, world, seed, or runtime arm
editing sealed V1/V2 receipts, the DEV-CAL-3 receipt, or the exonerated-component invariants (analysis outputs land under NEW names, never overwrite)
outcome-motivated N selection: N comes ONLY from the registered derivation rule; reading recovery outcomes into the N choice voids the study
editing exact/devcal3_charging_attribution.py, exact/run_devcal2.py, exact/devcal2_adapters.py or any src/ocm mechanism code (imported unchanged; drift = ASSAY_DEFECT)
